captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a wireless electronic dropper seatpost topped with a bicycle saddle. It features a dark grey or black outer tube containing a side-mounted battery compartment with a screw-cap, and a silver inner actuator post that moves vertically via a prismatic joint. The top of the inner post has a single-bolt saddle rail clamp plate supporting a black composite saddle shell on dual steel rails, allowing tilt adjustments via a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a wireless electronic dropper seatpost with a bicycle saddle. The assembly should include a cylindrical outer post, a side-mounted battery compartment with a hinge-connected cap, an adjustable inner post, and a saddle clamped to the top mount with tilt-adjustment capability.
captions.factory: The code constructs the seatpost assembly by first modeling the main outer tube using a cylinder, and adds a side-mounted battery housing with a revolute hinge for the screw-cap. A smaller silver cylinder is created for the inner actuator post and connected to the outer tube via a prismatic joint. The saddle clamp assembly is built at the top of the inner post, which clamps onto dual steel rails supporting a lofted or swept composite saddle shell, connected via a revolute joint for tilt adjustments.
